description: Update all GitHub Actions workflows to use Node.js version 24 instead of deprecated versions. This change will eliminate deprecation warnings in CI/CD pipelines and ensure compatibility with current Node.js releases.
functional_requirements: Update Node.js version specification in all GitHub Actions workflow YAML files to version 24
Ensure consistent Node.js version usage across all CI/CD pipelines (build, test, release workflows)
Maintain existing workflow functionality while updating Node.js version references
